cases.title: New charge uses new rule version

cases.actual: New charge uses newly saved rules in the application test.

cases.title: Repeated failure preserves first-failure clock

cases.title: Rule version zero defaults

cases.title: Reject invalid configuration

cases.title: Zero automatic retries
